(rule!
  (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
    (lambda (r c)
      (let ((left (= (safe-at g r (- c 1) 0) 1))
            (right (= (safe-at g r (+ c 1) 0) 1))
            (up (= (safe-at g (- r 1) c 0) 1))
            (down (= (safe-at g (+ r 1) c 0) 1)))
        (if (and (= (at g r c) 1)
                 (or (and left right (not up) (not down))
                     (and up down (not left) (not right))))
            2
            (at g r c))))))

(rule!
 (let ()
   (define (blue? r c)
     (= (safe-at g r c 0) 1))
   (define (count-dir r c dr dc)
     (let loop ((rr (+ r dr)) (cc (+ c dc)) (n 0))
       (if (blue? rr cc)
           (loop (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc) (+ n 1))
           n)))
   (define (horizontal-length r c)
     (if (blue? r c)
         (+ 1 (count-dir r c 0 -1) (count-dir r c 0 1))
         0))
   (define (vertical-length r c)
     (if (blue? r c)
         (+ 1 (count-dir r c -1 0) (count-dir r c 1 0))
         0))
   (define (segment-length r c)
     (max (horizontal-length r c) (vertical-length r c)))
   (define longest-length
     (apply max
            (for*/list ((r (range (rows g)))
                        (c (range (cols g))))
              (segment-length r c))))
   (grid-from-fn
    (rows g) (cols g)
    (lambda (r c)
      (let ((left (blue? r (- c 1)))
            (right (blue? r (+ c 1)))
            (up (blue? (- r 1) c))
            (down (blue? (+ r 1) c)))
        (if (and (= (at g r c) 1)
                 (= (segment-length r c) longest-length)
                 (or (and left right (not up) (not down))
                     (and up down (not left) (not right))))
            2
            (at g r c)))))))

(rule!
  (let* ((segments (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0)))
         (controller (pick-max segments obj-size))
         (controller-horizontal (> (obj-w controller) (obj-h controller))))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((left (= (safe-at g r (- c 1) 0) 1))
              (right (= (safe-at g r (+ c 1) 0) 1))
              (up (= (safe-at g (- r 1) c 0) 1))
              (down (= (safe-at g (+ r 1) c 0) 1)))
          (if (and (= (at g r c) 1)
                   (if controller-horizontal
                       (and up down (not left) (not right))
                       (and left right (not up) (not down))))
              2
              (at g r c)))))))
